entities.name: Broadcast MRB Establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to start receiving an MBS session of a broadcast service it is interested in.

entities.name: Broadcast MRB Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to stop receiving a session of an MBS broadcast service.

entities.name: MBS Session Start
entities.description: Condition where MBS session begins transmission.

entities.name: Enter Cell Providing MBS Service
entities.description: Condition where UE enters a cell that provides an MBS broadcast service the UE is interested in.

entities.name: Become Interested in MBS Service
entities.description: Condition where UE develops interest in an MBS broadcast service.

entities.name: Remove UE Capability Limitation
entities.description: Condition where UE capability limitations that inhibited MBS reception are removed.

entities.name: MBS Session Stop
entities.description: Condition where MBS session stops transmission.

entities.name: Leave Cell Broadcasting MBS Service
entities.description: Condition where UE leaves a cell that broadcasts an MBS service the UE is interested in.

entities.name: Lose Interest in MBS Service
entities.description: Condition where UE loses interest in an MBS broadcast service.

entities.name: UE Capability Limitation Starts
entities.description: Condition where UE capability limitations begin inhibiting reception of an MBS service.

relations.description: MBS session start triggers broadcast MRB establishment procedure.
Entering a cell providing MBS service triggers broadcast MRB establishment procedure.
Becoming interested in MBS service triggers broadcast MRB establishment procedure.
Removal of UE capability limitations triggers broadcast MRB establishment procedure.
MBS session stop triggers broadcast MRB release procedure.
Leaving cell broadcasting MBS service triggers broadcast MRB release procedure.
Losing interest in MBS service triggers broadcast MRB release procedure.
Start of UE capability limitations triggers broadcast MRB release procedure.
